user.title: Connect to HDL gateway
user.description: Enter the gateway IP. The integration scans the bus over UDP 6000; close HDL Buspro Setup Tool first, it occupies the same port.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: {count} device(s) found. Pick the ones to expose in Home Assistant.

mapping.title: Assign channel roles
mapping.description: Optional. Format: address/channel, comma separated, e.g. 10.100/9, 10.100/10. Channels left out become switches. Hint: {relay_hint}

error.cannot_connect: Gateway did not respond. Check IP, port and network.
error.no_devices: No device found. Check the subnet number.
error.port_in_use: Local UDP 6000 is busy. Close HDL tools or an old bridge process.
